description: This file contains the implementation of the MediaPipelineTestBase class, which provides a base for unit testing media pipeline components. It includes mock setup, media pipeline creation and destruction, and methods to simulate media source attachment, EOS handling, and data notification expectations.

classes.name: MediaPipelineTestBase
classes.description: A base class for unit testing media pipeline components, providing setup, teardown, and utility methods for media source management and expectations.

methods.name: createMediaPipeline
methods.description: Initializes the media pipeline with mocked dependencies and sets up main thread tasks.

methods.name: destroyMediaPipeline
methods.description: Cleans up and resets the media pipeline, unmapping resources and unregistering clients.

methods.name: mainThreadWillEnqueueTask
methods.description: Sets expectation for enqueuing a task on the main thread.

methods.name: mainThreadWillEnqueueTaskAndWait
methods.description: Sets expectation for enqueuing a task on the main thread and waiting for its completion.

methods.name: loadGstPlayer
methods.description: Loads a GStreamer player mock and triggers the load process.

methods.name: attachSource
methods.description: Attaches a media source (audio or video) to the media pipeline and returns its ID.

methods.name: setEos
methods.description: Simulates end-of-stream for a given media source type.

methods.name: expectNotifyNeedData
methods.description: Sets expectations for notifying the need for media data.

methods.name: expectNotifyNeedDataEos
methods.description: Sets expectations for notifying end-of-stream media data.
